newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.LANKA RUBBER PRICES BOUNCE AS RAIN HITS SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: S.LANKA RUBBER PRICES BOUNCE AS RAIN HITS SUPPLY.

text.p: Rubber prices at the Colombo auctions remained high on Thursday as rain in growing areas kept supplies low, brokers said.
"Supplies are low due to isolated showers in the early hours, when tapping takes place," said Upali Bandaranayake of brokerage Forbes & Walker.
"You need at least 10 days of continuous tapping to be able to get a good crop," he added.
Best latex one-x was at 88 rupees per kg after being unquoted last week.
Number one was at 87.50 rupees per kg from 84.50 and number two was at 82.75 from 79.25, brokers said.
"Though overall prices of better grades rose, there was about a two-rupee decline in the price of scrap grades," said one.
On offer was 196 tonnes, which was a below-average quantity, brokers said.
